product_metadata.title: SAYONAKUAJ Handheld Vacuum Cordless, Portable Hand Vacuum Cleaner 8000PA High Power USB Charge Ultra-Light Car Vacuum Cleaner for Home and Car Cleaning (Black)
features: 【8000PA STRONG SUCTION】No more crumbs, dust or dirt! With our Cordless Vacuum Cleaner you’ll be free of any wet or dry messes, cigarette ashes or pet hair, conveniently help you to tidy up every single corner of your vehicle and house

【LIGHTWEIGHT & CORDLESS】Portable Car Vacuum only 0.88 pounds, the lightest cordless vacuum on the market, which is 50% lighter than general cordless vacuums, without winding troubles.
